title: AdCoEvo: A Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Advertising Delivery System
abstract: arXiv:2610.19454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital advertising is an important means for platforms to reach potential users and drive business growth. Advertising delivery is the core link between marketing objectives and actual returns. Existing methods have achieved partial automation in individual tasks such as bidding and budget allocation, but they still rely on human operators for overall coordination, making it difficult to support large-scale operations. They also often fail to achieve optimal performance, and individual experience remains difficult to turn into reusable operational capabilities. In addition, as advertising markets change, advertising delivery systems need timely strategy updates to remain effective in dynamic markets. To automate the entire advertising operations process and improve adaptability to market changes, we propose AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system. translated_title: AdCoEvo：一种协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统
translated_abstract: 数字广告是平台触达潜在用户、驱动业务增长的重要手段，而广告投放是连接营销目标与实际收益的核心环节。现有方法在竞价、预算分配等单个任务上实现了部分自动化，但整体协调仍依赖人工操作，难以支撑大规模运营；这些方法往往也难以达到最优性能，且个体经验难以转化为可复用的运营能力。此外，随着广告市场不断变化，广告投放系统需要及时更新策略才能在动态市场中保持有效性。为了实现广告运营全流程的自动化并提升对市场变化的适应能力，我们提出了AdCoEvo，一个协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统。具体而言，该系统将不同环节的投放决策相互连接，协同进化……
tldr: 提出AdCoEvo——一种协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统，实现广告运营全流程自动化，并能适应动态市场变化。
en_tdlr: Proposes AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system that automates the entire advertising operations process and adapts to dynamic market changes.
